tool_input.content:
"""Job entrypoint: stage inputs, run the provided finetune script AS-IS, publish outputs.

Runs ON the Hopsworks platform. Downloads the three task inputs and the
unmodified finetune_model.py from HopsFS into the job working directory, then
executes finetune_model.py exactly as its author intended (run_name="__main__"
so its `if __name__ == "__main__"` guard fires and nothing is altered), then
uploads finetuned_model.npz and metrics.json back to HopsFS.
"""
import os
import runpy

import hopsworks

REMOTE_DIR = "Resources/ftjobcbc135"
OUTPUT_DIR = "Resources/ftjobcbc135/output"
INPUTS = ["base_model.npz", "finetune.txt", "eval.txt", "finetune_model.py"]
OUTPUTS = ["finetuned_model.npz", "metrics.json"]

project = hopsworks.login()
ds = project.get_dataset_api()

cwd = os.getcwd()
print("Job working directory:", cwd, flush=True)

for name in INPUTS:
    remote = f"{REMOTE_DIR}/{name}"
    local = os.path.join(cwd, name)
    if os.path.exists(local):
        os.remove(local)
    ds.download(remote, local_path=local, overwrite=True)
    print("downloaded", remote, "->", local, os.path.getsize(local), "bytes", flush=True)

# Run the provided script unmodified, in this working directory.
runpy.run_path(os.path.join(cwd, "finetune_model.py"), run_name="__main__")

for name in OUTPUTS:
    local = os.path.join(cwd, name)
    print("produced", name, os.path.getsize(local), "bytes", flush=True)
    ds.upload(local, OUTPUT_DIR, overwrite=True)
    print("uploaded", name, "->", OUTPUT_DIR, flush=True)

with open(os.path.join(cwd, "metrics.json")) as f:
    print("metrics.json:", f.read(), flush=True)
print("JOB_WRAPPER_DONE", flush=True)

tool_input.command:
set -e
hops files mkdir Resources/ftjobcbc135 2>&1 | tail -2
for f in base_model.npz finetune.txt eval.txt finetune_model.py; do
  hops files upload --overwrite data/$f Resources/ftjobcbc135/$f 2>&1 | tail -1
done
echo "==== LIST ===="
hops files list Resources/ftjobcbc135 2>&1 | tail -5
tool_input.description: Mkdir and upload data + script to HopsFS

tool_input.command: hops job deploy ftjobcbc135 .tmp/job_wrapper.py --type python --env python-feature-pipeline --run --wait 2>&1 | tail -40
tool_input.description: Deploy and run job, wait for completion

tool_input.command:
set -e
hops files list Resources/ftjobcbc135/output 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "==== DOWNLOAD ===="
mkdir -p .tmp/out
hops files download Resources/ftjobcbc135/output/metrics.json .tmp/out/metrics.json 2>&1 | tail -1
hops files download Resources/ftjobcbc135/output/finetuned_model.npz .tmp/out/finetuned_model.npz 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "==== METRICS ===="
cat .tmp/out/metrics.json
echo
ls -la .tmp/out/
tool_input.description: List output dir and download metrics + model

tool_input.command:
set -e
hops files download Resources/ftjobcbc135/output/metrics.json --output .tmp/out/metrics.json --overwrite 2>&1 | tail -1
hops files download Resources/ftjobcbc135/output/finetuned_model.npz --output .tmp/out/finetuned_model.npz --overwrite 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "==== METRICS ===="
cat .tmp/out/metrics.json; echo
ls -la .tmp/out/

hops model register ftmodelcbc135 .tmp/out/finetuned_model.npz \
  --framework python --version 1 \
  --metrics "eval_loss=3.3711,base_eval_loss=3.8136" \
  --description "Fine-tuned bigram char-LM (LoRA-style adapter) from ftjobcbc135" 2>&1 | tail -8
tool_input.description: Register fine-tuned model v1 with metrics
